description: A script for unzipping and installing vendor snapshots, generating Android.bp files, and checking module usage within an Android build environment.

methods.name: get_target_arch
methods.description: Extracts target architecture from JSON relative path.

methods.name: get_arch
methods.description: Extracts architecture from JSON relative path.

methods.name: get_variation
methods.description: Extracts variation type from JSON relative path.

methods.name: gen_bp_prop
methods.description: Converts a property dictionary into a formatted string for Android.bp.

methods.name: remove_invalid_dirs
methods.description: Filters out non-existent directories from a list, with warnings.

methods.name: convert_json_to_bp_prop
methods.description: Loads JSON file and converts it to Android.bp property dictionary.

methods.name: convert_json_data_to_bp_prop
methods.description: Converts JSON dictionary data into Android.bp property dictionary, validating paths.

methods.name: is_64bit_arch
methods.description: Checks if architecture string indicates 64-bit.

methods.name: remove_keys_from_dict
methods.description: Recursively removes specified keys from a dictionary.

methods.name: reexport_vndk_header
methods.description: Modifies architecture properties to re-export VNDK headers.

methods.name: gen_bp_module
methods.description: Generates Android.bp module string for a snapshot component.

methods.name: get_vndk_list
methods.description: Reads VNDK module names from a specified directory.

methods.name: gen_bp_list_module
methods.description: Creates a snapshot list module containing VNDK and other libraries.

methods.name: build_props
methods.description: Builds properties for all modules in a given install directory.

methods.name: convert_json_host_data_to_bp
methods.description: Creates blueprint for host modules from JSON data.

methods.name: gen_host_bp_file
methods.description: Generates Android.bp for host snapshot modules.

methods.name: gen_bp_files
methods.description: Generates Android.bp files for each architecture in the snapshot.

methods.name: find_all_installed_files
methods.description: Lists all installed files in a directory, excluding JSON and Android.bp files.

methods.name: find_files_in_props
methods.description: Finds files referenced in module properties and records info.

methods.name: find_all_props_files
methods.description: Builds a database of files to modules from all property files.

methods.name: get_ninja_inputs
methods.description: Uses ninja to get input files for specified modules.

methods.name: check_host_usage
methods.description: Checks which host modules are used in ninja build goals.

methods.name: check_module_usage
methods.description: Checks which modules are used based on ninja inputs.

methods.name: check_call
methods.description: Runs a command with debug logging.

methods.name: fetch_artifact
methods.description: Fetches build artifacts from Android build server.

methods.name: install_artifacts
methods.description: Installs vendor snapshot artifacts, either via fetch or local copy.

methods.name: get_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main program entry point handling snapshot installation and module usage checks.
